Happy birthday, my favorite person! 
 I honestly don’t even know where to start because there’s just so much I could say about you. It’s crazy to think how much we’ve grown together — all the random nights that turned into core memories, the deep talks, the ugly laughing fits, and the times we just sat in silence but still understood each other perfectly.
You’ve been there through so many of my chapters, and I can’t imagine my story without you in it. You’re not just my best friend; you’re truly family to me. You bring so much light into people’s lives — you have this rare mix of softness and strength that’s just beautiful to see.

Every year you grow into a better version of yourself, even when you don’t realize it. You’ve handled things with so much grace, even the hard moments that no one else saw. I hope you take a second today to be proud of yourself — because I really am.

You deserve everything good this world has to offer. The love, the success, the peace, the adventures — all of it. I just know that amazing things are waiting for you, and I can’t wait to see where life takes you next.

Thank you for being you. For being real, for being funny, for always hyping me up, and for making every ordinary moment feel special. I love how we can talk for hours or say nothing at all and still have the best time.

Here’s to another year of memories — more trips, spontaneous plans, matching outfits, and late-night talks about life and love. I’m so proud of you, and I love you endlessly.

Happy Birthday, beautiful. You truly deserve the world. 
Love you always,
